title: One Chance
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个人想学习射箭，于是找了一位射箭很厉害的师傅教他射箭。这个人拿起一张弓和两支箭准备试射。这时，师傅走了过来，拿走一支箭扔到了地上。"
您为什么把我的第二支箭拿走了呢？”徒弟惊讶地问。
"我拿走的不是第二支箭，是第一支，反正这支箭你也射不中箭靶。”师傅解释说。
"如果你射箭的时候，一直想着你还有一次机会，你就不会珍惜第一次机会，所以有没有第一支箭都一样。”师傅回答。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個人想學習射箭，於是找了一位射箭很厲害的師傅教他射箭。這個人拿起一張弓和兩支箭準備試射。這時，師傅走了過來，拿走一支箭扔到了地上。"
您為什麼把我的第二支箭拿走了呢？”徒弟驚訝地問。
"我拿走的不是第二支箭，是第一支，反正這支箭你也射不中箭靶。”師傅解釋說。
"如果你射箭的時候，一直想著你還有一次機會，你就不會珍惜第一次機會，所以有沒有第一支箭都一樣。”師傅回答。

english_paragraphs: A man wanted to learn archery, so he found a skilled archer to teach him. He picked up a bow and two arrows, ready to take a practice shot. Just then, his teacher came over, took one of the arrows, and threw it on the ground.
“Why did you take away my second arrow?” the student asked in surprise.
“I didn’t take away your second arrow. I took away your first. You wouldn’t have hit the target with it anyway,” the teacher explained.
“If you keep thinking you have another chance when you shoot, you won’t make the most of your first chance. So it makes no difference whether you have that first arrow,” the teacher replied.
english_full:
A man wanted to learn archery, so he found a skilled archer to teach him. He picked up a bow and two arrows, ready to take a practice shot. Just then, his teacher came over, took one of the arrows, and threw it on the ground.

“Why did you take away my second arrow?” the student asked in surprise.

“I didn’t take away your second arrow. I took away your first. You wouldn’t have hit the target with it anyway,” the teacher explained.

“Why not?” the student asked, puzzled.

“If you keep thinking you have another chance when you shoot, you won’t make the most of your first chance. So it makes no difference whether you have that first arrow,” the teacher replied.
